object.attr: stakeholder: a newer Mellon can add elements or XML attributes that an older one doesn't know, as next-object-number did; an older Mellon that drops them on rewrite loses data while a team mixes versions. 0.3.0 was checked to keep next-object-number (open question Q7). Decided on 2026-11-10. Comments count in the canonical form, so they are kept too (Q-S11).
object.description: When Mellon rewrites a data file, Mellon shall change the file's canonical form only by the change being made.
